name: pipaya-extension-hermes
description: The learning loop of Hermes Agent: bounded memory of you and your environment, search over every past conversation, skills the agent writes and improves itself, and an orchestrator session that is your single point of contact.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: Ports the learning loop of Nous Research's Hermes Agent: a bounded profile of you (USER.md) and notes on your environment (MEMORY.md) put into every new session, the session_search tool over every past conversation, skills the agent writes and improves in ~/.agents/skills, a review after every few turns that updates them, and an orchestrator session (/hermes on) that hands work to other sessions.
descriptions.ko: Nous Research의 Hermes Agent 학습 루프를 옮겨 왔습니다. 사용자 프로필(USER.md)과 환경 메모(MEMORY.md)를 새 세션마다 넣어 주고, 모든 과거 대화를 찾는 session_search 도구, 에이전트가 ~/.agents/skills에 직접 쓰고 고치는 스킬, 몇 턴마다 이것들을 갱신하는 자동 복기, 다른 세션에 일을 나눠 주는 오케스트레이터 세션(/hermes on)을 더합니다.

settings.label: Put memory into new sessions
settings.description: Adds USER.md and MEMORY.md to the system prompt of every session, as a snapshot taken at its first message.

settings.label: Review conversations automatically
settings.description: After a few messages from you, a model reads the conversation and updates memory and skills.

settings.label: Messages between reviews
settings.description: How many of your messages a session needs since its last review before the next one runs.

settings.label: Let it write skills
settings.description: The review and the skill_manage tool may create and improve skills in ~/.agents/skills.

settings.label: Let it edit skills it did not write
settings.description: Off: only skills Hermes created (created-by: hermes) can be changed.

settings.label: Model role for reviews
settings.description: A model role from Settings > Models. Without a mapping the default model is used.
